stays.headline: One night in Athens, three ways to do it
paras: You land the morning of June 8, which is enough for the Acropolis, a long lunch and an early night before the ferry. I've quoted three hotels for the night, all refundable, so pick the one that suits you.

A77 Suites is twelve suites in a restored 19th-century house in Plaka, a short walk to the Acropolis. Xenodocheio Milos is the hotel from Estiatorio Milos, with a MICHELIN Key and great seafood downstairs. Conrad Athens is the full-service option, with a big pool terrace and spa.

stays.headline: Vione, quiet design and your own pool
paras: Vione is the kind of hotel that quietly impresses you. Newer, quieter and more private than the other Paros options, with clean architecture, understated interiors and the best sunset of the bunch.
Naoussa's old port is ten minutes away for dinner, and the boat day leaves for Antiparos and Despotiko from just down the coast.

card.label: Your suite · 4 nights
rows: Junior Suite, private pool, sea view
card.perks: Fora Reserve perks: a welcome amenity, €100 food and beverage credit, early check-in or late check-out and an upgrade when available.

stays.headline: Canaves Ena, eighteen suites on the caldera
paras: Ena is where the Canaves story started, in suites that trace back to 17th-century wine caves. With just 18 suites it feels intimate, and it sits higher on the caldera than most, so it is noticeably more private.
It is at the entrance to Oia's lane rather than in the middle of it, so it stays quiet, and the swim-up pool bar is a fun extra on a honeymoon.

card.perks: $100 food and beverage credit at the pool bar, wine and fruit on arrival and an upgrade when available.
card.fine: Free cancellation until May 23, 2027. Climate tax of €15 per person a night, paid at checkout.
